text_block_list.text: I'm out shopping on a day off, when…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! No way! You gotta wear something sparklier than that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch. Who even cares what I look like?
choice_data_list: You two came out shopping together?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sigh… More like, she invited herself to my shopping trip.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, boo! It's not my fault you don't have any party clothes!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You're gonna get invited to a bunch of things once you make your debut, right? Pre-race parties, victory parties, the works!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Thinking of you going to all of those events in your uniform is just, well unthinkable!
choice_data_list: I don't think it would be inappropriate…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Agh, that's not the issue! …I guess I've just got to teach the both of you!
And just like that, I'm roped into going shopping with them…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ooh! That dress is so beautiful! ♪ It's a nice change of pace from your edgy signature racewear!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I don't like it. If you tear up the hem a bit, I might consider it though.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Are you crazy?! The whole point is that it's cute! You can't rip it up!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: How about this jumpsuit?! It has a short hem and the legs are stylish. ♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Nope. The loud color drowns out everything else.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You've gotta be kidding! What's the point of getting all dressed up if you're not even gonna sparkle?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Ugghh! We can't decide on anything!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: There's no need to decide on anything in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: No way! After all this, we're definitely buying something! You'll see!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Come on! What kind of clothes are good? You can't hate everything!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I don't really care, but if I have to choose…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Something easy to run in.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Easy to run in?! This is supposed to be for parties!
If it's something easy to run in, then I can only really think of…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A suit… Well, at least it wouldn't be too flashy.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I don't know if it'll sparkle or not… but let's go check out the store.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hm… The fabric stretches well when I lift my legs. This looks like it'd be easy to run in.

text_block_list.name: Clothing Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Very tough! It suits you perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yesss! You hear that?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …I'm surprised. We actually found something good.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I learned a lot too! Even clothes that are cool can sparkle!
I'd say this shopping trip went pretty well!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A tracksuit… I see. I guess that's an option.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Stoooppp! A tracksuit at a party?! I don't even wanna imagine that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the invitation.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Cheers.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I don't see a problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You serious?! No, no, NO! Wearing your uniform would be a hundred times better!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Geez… That's what I've been saying from the start.
And so, our ridiculous shopping trip comes to a close.
